name: Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund (KNCF) Grant Program
summary: Annual grants from Japan's business federation fund for NGOs running biodiversity conservation, related social and capacity-building projects in developing countries, mainly in the Asia-Pacific, or in Japan, from small first-time grants to three-year collaboration grants.

geography.label: Developing countries mainly in the Asia-Pacific region, or Japan

amount.note: Collaboration grants, for projects run jointly by several NGOs

reporting: Grantees submit an interim report and a final report through the KNCF online system on fixed dates; Collaboration Grant holders report in person each year instead of an interim report.

status.quote: Please submit your application within the application period listed below.

administered_by.quote: Please make any inquiries regarding Guidelines, Application and reports to the trustee, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Ltd.

applicant_types.quote: It has incorporated status or is a voluntary organization with societal credibility equivalent to an incorporated organization.

geography.quote: Region: Activities that are based in developing countries mainly in the Asia-Pacific region or inside Japan.

access.quote: Organizations that wish to receive grants under the Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund (KNCF) Grant Program are asked to confirm the application details below and submit the "Application Documents" following the listed application procedures.

amount.quote: Large-size grant with an upper annual limit of 20 million Yen with the requirement that applying projects are collaborative projects involving multiple non-governmental organizations.

reporting.quote: Organizations that have received grants must submit an "Interim Report" by October 31st, 2027, 17:00 (Strictly adhere to the deadline).
